text:
maria: Heads up — last 30m we've seen repeated GPU throttle spikes in ucentral-rt after the new embedding blackbox rollout. Flatline-ish pods, eviction churn and increased tail latency for streaming endpoints.

jordan: ack. alert graph?

maria: https://grafana.redwood/ucentral/d/streaming — CPU fine, but `gpu_pressure_percentage` jumps to 85-95% right before `inference_stream_latency_seconds_bucket` tail moves. spikes line up with `blackbox_probe_embedding_concurrency` jobs.

kai: are these the new dense-embedding probes that ramp concurrency across shards? I remember we increased concurrency from 4 -> 12 for sampling.

maria: yup. rollout happened ~1795123300 via probe-configs. The probe-bot run shows parallel runs across 6 pools.

probe-bot: [1795123320] starting embedding_probe run id=run-cc92, concurrency=12, targets=ucentral-rt{pool="dedicated-a"}

natalie: hmm. sounds like probes are saturating the GPU queue. Are they using streaming path or batch/generation?

maria: embeddings call path (`/v1/embeddings`) — uses the same model runner but different batching profile. Under high concurrency it forces larger batch formation and long kernel queue times.

ash: quick mitigation: reduce probe concurrency and stagger. Also add a KV-cache warmup check so probes can use cached prefixes and avoid expensive cold runs.
jordan: agree. propose: rollback concurrency to 4, add jittered start windows, and change probe to first do a small prefix request to populate cache.

maria: putting a hotfix patch to the blackbox config now:
```
# sources/observability/probes/ucentral-embedding-probe.yaml
concurrency: 4
start_jitter_seconds: 30
prewarm_prefix: "/prefetch:quick"
max_retries: 2
```

kai: also want to tune alerts. Current `SRE GPU Pressure` fires at 70% for 1m — noisy during probe runs. Maybe track `blackbox_probe_active_runs` and suppress or increase threshold if probe-run-tag present.
natalie: or add a `blackbox_probe_traffic` label and have an override rule in the alerting chain. We can use Alertmanager inhibition: if `probe_run=1` then silence the `gpu_pressure` alert for that pool for 5m. But that hides real issues if probes go rogue.

ash: better: change alert to `gpu_pressure_percentage > 80% for 3m AND not (probe_run_active == 1)` and create a new alert `probe_induced_gpu_pressure` that fires at 85% even when probes active. That way on-call sees probe-related vs organic pressure.

maria: +1. I'll open a PR with the Prometheus rule changes. Draft rule:
```
- alert: GPUHighPressure
  expr: gpu_pressure_percentage{pool="dedicated-a"} > 0.8
  for: 3m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "GPU pressure high in {{ $labels.pool }}"
- alert: ProbeInducedGPUPressure
  expr: gpu_pressure_percentage > 0.85 and probe_run_active == 1
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: ticket
```

probe-bot: [1795123401] run-id=run-cc92 results: 10/120 succeeded, median latency 210ms, tail 1.9s, kvcache_hit_ratio=0.02

jordan: that success ratio is alarming — why so low? 120 targets? maybe we hit network egress or token limits.

maria: most failures are 503/504 streaming handshake timeouts. logs show `socket timeout during handshake` and `gpu-queue-full` in runner traces.

ash: ops checklist:
- roll concurrency back to 4 (hotfix deployed)
- enable prewarm_prefix for probes (patch deployed)
- add jitter windows and per-pool cap
- promote new Prom rule with probe-aware conditions
- create a Grafana panel for `blackbox_probe_success_rate` and `kvcache_hit_ratio` per-pool

kai: for longer-term: we should implement a probe throttle controller that reads `gpu_pressure_percentage` and adaptively reduces probe concurrency. Similar to circuit-breaker for canaries.
natalie: agree. Also add a lower-cost probe mode for embeddings that asks for `dimension=64` test embeddings or uses quantized model variants to avoid full-cost runs.

maria: logging runbook note: if `probe_induced_gpu_pressure` triggers, on-call should: check `probe_run_active` tag, reduce concurrency via `kubectl patch configmap probe-config`, and set `probe_run_pause=true` for 10m while verifying KV-cache warmups.

ash: I'll draft a short runbook and add to incidents repo. We should also schedule a canary test: run the original concurrency=12 but target 1 node only and monitor `inference_stream_latency_seconds` and `gpu_queue_depth`.

jordan: nits for alert tuning: use `increase(blackbox_probe_errors_total[5m]) / increase(blackbox_probe_runs_total[5m]) > 0.05` for error-rate alert instead of absolute counts. That scales across pools.

maria: action items assigned:
- maria: hotfix + PR for probe config and runbook (done/hotfix deployed)
- jordan: PR for Prometheus rules (in review)
- kai: prototype adaptive throttle controller (POC branch)
- natalie: add low-cost embedding probe variant and Grafana panels
- ash: schedule canary run and monitor next window @ 1795124100

probe-bot: [1795123500] new run scheduled id=run-dd33 concurrency=4 prewarm=true

sre-bot: incident-note created: INC-2027-0423 — "ucentral embedding probe causing transient GPU pressure" (severity: S2)

maria: thanks all — keeping this thread for postmortem notes. Will paste PR links here once merged. :thumbsup:
